home.heading: Play Abalone free, no account
home.lede: Push six of your opponent's marbles off the board. <trust>Free to play, no sign-up and no download.</trust>
home.play_online_link: Play Abalone online with a friend

free.question: Can I play Abalone online for free?
free.answer: Yes. Abalone here is free to play in your browser, with no download. You can start a game against the computer straight away without making an account. A free account is only needed when you want to play a friend online.

account.question: Do I need an account to play Abalone?
account.answer: No, not to play the computer or to pass the device between two players. Those modes start instantly with no sign-up. You only need a free account to play a friend online, because online games and invites are tied to a username.

computer.question: Can I play Abalone against the computer?
computer.answer: Yes. Pick Play now to face the computer. There are eight bots, from easy to hard, so beginners and experienced players both find a fair opponent. It is free, needs no sign-up, and you can stop or restart whenever you like.

one_device.question: Can two people play Abalone on one device?
one_device.answer: Yes. Choose Pass & Play and take turns on the same screen. It needs no account and no sign-up. One player uses black and the other white, and black moves first, as in a normal game. It is a good way to teach a beginner.
